title: Confined sessions cannot read the host user's package-manager credentials
description: With a fixture HOME holding ~/.npmrc with an auth token and its siblings (.yarnrc.yml, .pypirc, .gem/credentials, .cargo/credentials.toml), a confined worker under real bubblewrap reads none of them, and npm install of a public package in its worktree still succeeds.

steps.name: host package-manager credentials masked from a confined worker
